The Mona Lisa is located in the Louvre.
The van Gogh self-portrait is located in the Musée d'Orsay.
The Louvre is under an hour walk from the Eiffel Tower.
The Musée d'Orsay is under an hour walk from the Eiffel Tower.
The Thierry Marx restaurant (Madame Brasserie) is located at the first floor of the Eiffel Tower.
